description:
How visible the workspace's own brand is in AI answers: the share of AI answers that mention it, overall and per AI model (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Mistral, Google AI Overviews), and the change from the window before.

Use this tool when the user asks about current performance -- phrases like 'how are we doing', 'what's our score', 'how visible are we in AI', or 'current visibility'.
Do NOT use for trends over time (use get_visibility_trend) or competitors (use get_competitor_comparison).

Returns: visibility in percent (null means no answers to measure, not zero), the change in percentage points, one row per model with its visibility and number of answers, and a summary.

Example: 'How is Kassaro doing in AI search right now?'

days.description: How many days back to look, counted back from end_date (default today). Default 30, max 90. Ignored when start_date is given. Prompts are re-run on a schedule, so a window shorter than a week can be empty.
days.title: Days

end_date.description: Optional end of the window, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default today. Cannot be in the future.
end_date.title: End Date

start_date.description: Optional explicit start of the window, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). A full ISO datetime is accepted and its date is used. Overrides days.
start_date.title: Start Date

workspace_id.description: The workspace's numeric id, as returned by list_workspaces.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: get_visibility_score
title: Visibility score
